head.description: The token and original storage are checked on every request, including cached image variants. Anyone with a valid file URL can download it, including party attachments after leaving the party. Optional w and h contain a supported still image inside the requested box without upscaling. Dimensions must be integers from 1 to 2048. Images over 16 MiB or 16 million pixels, animated images, unsupported formats, and images with orientation or color-profile metadata retain their original bytes. Busy image processing also serves the original. Responses are not stored by browsers or shared caches. Byte ranges and HEAD describe the selected representation. Omit w and h to download the original.
